all operator fragments of CTL, except the one containing solely AX, are W[1]-complete under parameterization by the sum of temporal and structural pathwidth, and the fragment containing only AX is fixed-parameter tractable.
the parameterized complexity classification of the satisfiability of CTL is almost complete.
all fragments of CTL are either W[1]-complete or FPT, except for the one which contains only the operator AX.

the question how much of the expressivity of CTL can be captured by a parameterized algorithm.
the question whether the satisfiability problem for CTL is fixed-parameter tractable or W[1]-complete.
the question whether the complexity of the CTL model-checking problem can be reduced to the complexity of the satisfiability of propositional logic by restricting the set of operators.
